title: Pai Gow Poker

hintReason.strongBothHands: Both hands are strong — set as recommended
hintReason.splitResult: Split hands for better odds — set carefully
hintReason.weakBothHands: Both hands are weak — balance your set

selectLowHand: Select 2 cards for your low hand
foulWarning: Foul: the low hand outranks the high hand
foulRuleHelp: Split the 7 cards into a 5-card high hand and a 2-card low hand. The 2-card low hand must rank lower than the 5-card high hand — if the low hand is stronger, it is a foul.
betError: Bet must be at least 10, in steps of 10, and within your balance

tutorial.betControls: Set your bet amount and press Bet.
tutorial.setHands: Select 2 cards from your 7 to form the low hand, then press Set. Press Auto Set to arrange a reasonable, foul-free split automatically using the house way.
tutorial.results: Check your high hand and low hand results here.

frontendHint.paigowBet: Place a bet to be dealt seven cards
frontendHint.paigowAutoSplit: Press auto-split (A) to take the strongest legal two-card hand
frontendHint.paigowSplitByHand: Auto-split is unavailable with the joker — split so the five-card hand beats the two-card hand

foulHighMustBeat: Foul: the two-card low hand must be weaker than the five-card high hand
